test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word.

The historian arranged all the events in a __cronalogical__ order.
solution:
The correct answer is **"chronological".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence,** 'The historian arranged all the events in a cronalogical order,' **the underlined word, **'cronalogical,' **is **incorrect.**
 
• The correct spelling of the word, which refers to the order of events as they happened in time, is** 'chronological.'**
 
• Therefore, in the provided multiple-choice options, "Option 1".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Chronological' **is derived from the Greek words **'chronos' (time) **and **'logos' (study), **essentially meaning **'the study of time.' **
 
• When events are arranged in **'chronological order,' **they are listed according to when they happened, from the earliest to the most recent.
